// doc: Plano 23 · D0 — editor/type-check config for the no-build-step ESM frontend.
Global type-checking is OFF (`checkJs: false`): the runtime is raw HTM + an
import-map (web/index.html), with no bundler/transpile pass, so we never want
tsc to fail the whole tree. Type-checking is OPT-IN PER FILE via a `// @ts-check`
comment at the top of the module (today: utils/phone.js,
annotated with JSDoc typedefs on their exports). Verify with:
